title: Consumer Goods
meta: Lean and process improvement for Canadian consumer goods companies: protect product margins, cut non-value-added time and serve customers better every day.
h1: Raise product margins while giving customers more of what they value
lead: We help consumer goods companies remove waste across production and the supply chain while measuring the value customers actually receive. Your team gets the tools to keep improving in a competitive market.
intro: Can you grow margins and the customer experience at the same time?

In consumer goods, rising input costs, retailer demands and shifting consumer tastes squeeze margins from every side. Cutting costs alone can hurt the experience that keeps customers buying. We engage your operations directly, observing work as it happens on the floor, in the warehouse and across the supply chain to find non-value-added time and inefficient processes. Then we build customer-centric operating measures that give your team daily data on the value delivered. With a customized continuous improvement framework, your people can control processing costs, improve production efficiency and respond faster to the market.
signs: Product margins are shrinking even as sales volumes hold
Changeovers between SKUs eat into production time
Retailer fill rate or on-time delivery targets are often missed
Supervisors spend more time firefighting than managing
You track output, but not the value customers receive
challenges: Rising ingredient, packaging and freight costs, plus retailer pricing pressure, leave little room for waste in production and fulfilment.
More variants, pack sizes and promotions mean more changeovers, more inventory and more chances for errors.
When purchasing, production and shipping plan separately, the result is stockouts, excess inventory and expedited freight.
Team leads and managers are pulled into admin and urgent issues, leaving little time to coach people and improve processes.
services: We build a KPI framework covering service levels, productivity, speed and quality, with daily measures of the value delivered to your customers.
We observe production, packing and fulfilment as they happen to separate value-added work from waiting, motion and rework, revealing hidden capacity.
We map how demand, purchasing, production and shipping connect, then remove the gaps that drive cost and missed deliveries.
We analyze team lead and manager roles to find ways to increase active management time on the floor.
We identify and help implement simple process improvements that need no new systems, so results start early.
We assess change readiness and work with leadership to implement tools that turn your strategic plan into activities every employee understands.

config.fix_title: Fixed: a shared demand plan and focused SKUs
config.fix_text: Sales and planning build one demand plan, slow SKUs are rationalized, and safety stock covers the top sellers. Planners see available stock in one place, so orders are confirmed quickly and rush runs become the exception.

why.title: Why consumer goods companies choose Chmltech
why.text: We learn your operation by watching it run, then build improvements with the people who do the work.
points: Our process engineer's approach starts on the floor, observing work as it happens rather than relying on reports alone.
We measure the value delivered to customers alongside cost, so efficiency gains never come at the expense of the experience.
Your team owns the changes and the continuous improvement framework, so gains continue after the project ends.

faq: Do you work with food and beverage producers?
Yes. Our methods apply to food, beverage, personal care and household goods producers, and we respect your food safety and quality requirements when changing processes.
How quickly will we see results?
We look for quick wins that need no new systems early in the project, such as standard changeovers or simpler reporting. Larger changes follow a plan with milestones measured against your baseline.
Can you help with SKU rationalization?
Yes. We analyze margin, volume and complexity by SKU so you can see which products earn their place and which drive cost through changeovers and inventory.
What does a team lead role assessment involve?
We observe how team leads and managers spend their time, then identify admin and firefighting that can be reduced so they spend more time actively managing people and processes.
